title: Stale 'Choose the start date.' error stays after a start date is picked
steps: 1. Sign in as a new user, enter a society code, pick a flat, choose Tenant. 2. On 'Your tenancy' press Save and continue with no dates. 3. Pick an agreement start date. 4. Press Save and continue again (end date still empty).
expected: Only 'Choose the end date.' is shown; the start-date error clears once a start date is chosen.
actual: The start field shows '15 Dec 2026' and still shows 'Choose the start date.' in red beside 'Choose the end date.'. On a fresh form with the start picked first, only the end error appears, so the start error is stale.
environment: Local dev: Next.js dev server http://localhost:3000 (turbopack), local Supabase, headless Chrome 1280x900, 2026-11-10

title: Proof upload accepts any file content when the request claims application/pdf
steps: 1. Sign in as tenant 28 (open tenant registration). 2. POST a Windows .exe body to /storage/v1/object/parisar-proofs/<society>/<own user id>/x.pdf with Content-Type: application/pdf.
expected: Upload refused: file content (magic bytes) does not match an allowed type.
actual: HTTP 200, object stored. The bucket checks only the declared MIME type and size (an honest .exe type gets 415, >10 MB gets 413). The browser check is extension-based only. Same family as CORE-007 (complaint photos not content-validated). Test object left in storage: .../1c6d6055-a9e7-4035-aca2-57a1d0d40269/qa-exe-as.pdf.
environment: Local dev: Next.js dev server http://localhost:3000 (turbopack), local Supabase, headless Chrome 1280x900, 2026-11-10
api_error: storage 200 for .exe bytes sent as application/pdf

title: Invite link /invite/<token> returns HTTP 500 for any signed-in user
steps: 1. Sign in as any user (e.g. 9000000025). 2. Open a family invite link http://localhost:3000/invite/<64-hex token> (valid, used or random).
expected: Signed-in users are redirected to /join/invite/<token> and see the invite preview or a clear invalid message.
actual: HTTP 500 'Something went wrong' error page. Console: 'INVITE_TOKEN_RE.test is not a function'. app/invite/[token]/page.jsx (server component) imports INVITE_TOKEN_RE from components/join/InviteLanding.jsx, which is a 'use client' module, so on the server the export is a client reference, not a RegExp. Signed-out users are unaffected; an invitee already signed in on their phone cannot open the link they were sent.
environment: Local dev: Next.js dev server http://localhost:3000 (turbopack), local Supabase, headless Chrome 1280x900, 2026-11-10
api_error: HTTP 500 GET /invite/<token>; PAGEERROR INVITE_TOKEN_RE.test is not a function
